ORIENT.rule: Load the exact current A+B pair first; provider fabric only supplies operational bindings and may not override A+B.

DOMAIN_RETRIEVE.rule: Executor derives privacy-approved candidates and uses A dependency_semantics to traverse every declared hard prerequisite before dependent-domain reads. Candidate discovery remains available for exact prerequisite probes; after fresh route observations, an unresolved hard prerequisite withholds dependent targets and returns HARD_PREREQUISITE_UNRESOLVED. Contextual dependencies are traversed afterward under the visited-set/budget rules and are non-blocking merely because their own routes remain unresolved. Returned items require exact route/source/privacy checks plus an independently composed runtime-owned item type/currentness verifier; a route capability set is permission to return a type, never proof that the returned item actually has that type.

FAILURE_EVALUATE.rule: Evaluate a declared failure signature only as an executable candidate trigger: required signal co-occurrence routes to the signature's declared resolver or fail-closed guard. CANDIDATE_TRIGGERED does not prove the prose predicate true and creates no authority; the selected resolver/guard must decide the material proposition from typed current evidence.

PROJECTION_RECONCILE.rule: For one registered projection, apply ref/path scope and privacy gates before provider I/O; carry the exact caller event ref/path across both adapter reads; give collection targets the registered provider-native event selector; independently validate returned item type/currentness/event provenance; and require both returned observations to bind that exact event before reconciliation. Missing event binding is UNRESOLVED, binding to the wrong event is CONFLICT, and matching revisions for the wrong event never qualify as VERIFIED_EXACT. EXACT_RECEIPT additionally validates configured receipt schema/type, source/target subjects, source object locator/revision/digest, exact event, and exact receipt locator/digest; receipt proof is not revision equality.

PROJECTION_AUDIT.rule: Supplied-observation audit cannot mint VERIFIED_EXACT from caller-shaped event metadata. It may preserve an exact candidate only when the exact source and target envelope objects already carry runtime-owned provider/object/event provenance established at the read boundary; otherwise the exact candidate is UNRESOLVED.

RECONCILE.rule: Compare exact revision/generation/digest evidence only after exact event-instance binding; observation timestamps never break exact-object conflicts. EXACT_RECEIPT uses its separate receipt/object reconciliation path and may not be reduced to revision equality.

ADMIT_PROPOSITION.rule: After typing/currentness reconciliation, select the matching resolver_dispatch row for the exact domain/proposition/referent tuple before terminal resolver acceptance. Readable or VERIFIED_EXACT provider evidence remains insufficient when the selected dispatch requires a different decisive evidence class; missing or ambiguous dispatch fails closed.

CHECKPOINT.rule: Persist only minimum-necessary pointers/digests/status needed to resume; never copy specialist payloads merely for convenience.

adapter_boundary.probe_contract: Adapter reports transport observation for the exact requested route only; reachability does not establish currentness, authority, or evidence type.
adapter_boundary.read_contract: Adapter returns one ProviderEvidenceEnvelope for the exact requested route/source/event or explicitly absent when the exact object is not present. Projection requests carry the exact caller event ref/path and, where configured, a provider-native event selector. Executor revalidates provider identity, route/source/event binding and privacy class, then requires a separately composed runtime-owned item verifier to derive the actual evidence class/currentness/event provenance from provider/object/receipt provenance before comparing that derived class with the target capability ceiling. The ordinary retrieval adapter and its returned envelope cannot self-certify item type or qualifying event binding. Absence is not silently converted into unavailability or success.
adapter_boundary.credential_rule: Credentials/configuration remain runtime/provider concerns and are never embedded in this source hook or provider fabric.

background_execution.rule: Source code and this hook do not execute between turns by themselves. Active-runtime execution occurs only when a runtime invokes the hook. Offscreen continuous monitoring requires a separately evidenced scheduler/runtime invocation.

effect_boundaries.source: Repository source establishes the hook design and executable support only; it does not establish native installation, activation, provider effect, runtime consumption, or behavioral qualification.
effect_boundaries.installation: Native installation requires exact native readback binding this exact hook/A+B/provider-fabric tuple.
effect_boundaries.runtime_consumption: Runtime consumption requires observable execution evidence for the exact runtime/operation and cannot be inferred from source presence.
effect_boundaries.provider_effect: Provider mutation requires separate operation-specific authority plus exact readback; this hook alone authorizes no provider write.
effect_boundaries.qualification: Behavioral qualification requires separately executed exact-tuple qualification including fresh live-provider replay; source tests and live provider reads do not self-qualify Vera.

promotion_guards: Provider persistence is not present truth or current Vera self-state.
Temporal chronology is not semantic/currentness authority.
Retrieved item type/currentness/event provenance must be independently established outside the ordinary retrieval adapter; capability is never item type.
A hard prerequisite is a governing retrieval gate, not automatic proposition authority; resolver/admission checks remain separate.
A contextual dependency may inform the task but unresolved contextual retrieval does not become an authority/currentness veto.
Failure-signature signal co-occurrence is a candidate trigger, not proof that the declared semantic predicate is true.
Projection revision equality or caller-shaped event metadata without runtime-owned event provenance is not VERIFIED_EXACT.
Supplied-observation projection audit cannot mint VERIFIED_EXACT on weaker evidence than the provider read path.
EXACT_RECEIPT requires exact receipt schema/type/event/object subject/digest validation; same revision is not receipt proof.
VERIFIED_EXACT reconciliation is not proposition authority; resolver dispatch remains a separate gate.
Operational checkpoint state never silently becomes autobiographical/current-self-state memory.
Patrick authority and Vera self-authored stance remain actor/referent/proposition specific.
Adapter availability and scheduler output are operational evidence only and never policy authority.
